1.title: Prosecutor Reduces Charges Against L.A.P.D. Whistle-Blower After Uproar
1.summary: A Los Angeles officer faced prison for secretly recording colleagues making offensive remarks. The county prosecutor is reducing those charges after critics said they would discourage whistle-blowers.

2.title: Lindsay Clancy's trial put postpartum psychosis in the spotlight. Experts want progress to follow
2.summary: Postpartum psychosis is a psychiatric emergency that can involve mania, depression, hallucinations and delusions.

3.title: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, a Pragmatic Democrat, Makes Runoff for Alaska Governor
3.summary: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state legislator from Sitka, Alaska, will be one of four candidates on the ranked-choice voting ballot in November.

4.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
4.summary: The man is alleged to have been one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the pipelines in 2022.

5.title: Two detained after French influencer's scorched body found in vineyard
5.summary: Sonia Bellina's body was "abandoned" after "a murder of rare savagery", the family's lawyer says.

6.title: U.A.E. Announces Halt to Trade With Iran Amid Trump’s Push To Isolate Tehran
6.summary: The Emirates has long been a major trading hub for Iran, and analysts say it has been key to Iranian efforts to evade international sanctions, which Emirati officials deny.
